subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding what a stock is: owning a small piece of a company
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student divides a physical 'company' model into equal shares, each representing partial ownership
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a described stock purchase to what it actually represents (partial company ownership)
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, what it means to own a share of stock in a company

misconception_flags: believes buying a stock means lending the company money rather than owning a piece of it

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
